messages:
Anna: Quick heads-up — Nebula Health private deploy handoff scheduled for tomorrow 10:00 PT. Wanted to list open blockers and owners so we can go into the cutover with clear handoffs. cc @Marie @Kai @Josh

Kai: I can own network gating and firewall rules. Current open: Nebula asked for 443 egress to vendor X and restricted NTP. I need confirmation on proxy hostname and whether we should allow outbound to artifact repo IPs.

Marie: Working with Nebula on the final SOC questionnaire; legal finished the DPA. Customer confirmed they can open 443 to artifactory.redwood-infra.internal and to package-signing.redwood. Still waiting on SOC control 7.2 answer (expected EOD).

Josh: Airgap plan: we'll rsync signed artifacts to their airlock server, then they pull into their private registry. Need to sign images with the customer KMS thumbprint. Command we ran in staging:
```
./sign-artifact --kms-key projects/nebula/keys/prod --artifact build/redwood-inference:v2.3.1
rsync -av --progress dist/ nebula@airlock:/incoming/
```
Also PR #4523 contains the image manifest changes — can someone review so we can bump image tag during cutover?

SRE-Bot: smoke-checker triggered: staging cluster smoke passed (end-to-end requests 200/200). Canary deploy job queued for 09:30 PT.

DevOps-Bot: deploy checklist: 1) confirm FW (Kai) 2) push signed artifacts (Josh) 3) KMS access validated (Marie) 4) run smoke (SRE) 5) rollback plan documented (Anna). Checklist doc: https://internal.redwood/handbooks/private-cutover

Anna: @Josh — pinging on PR #4523 review, small manifest diff + test. @Kai can you paste the exact firewall CIDR(s) you'll request? I'll add to the runbook.

Kai: I'll request these: 35.192.10.0/24 (artifactory), 34.120.44.8/32 (signing service) and allow 443/TCP to package-signing.redwood.internal. Sending to Nebula ops now.

Marie: KMS note: Nebula wants customer-managed key. We need to confirm rotation window. Who will handle the key import handshake? My guess: Josh + security.

Josh: I'll own the signer handshake and import steps with Security. Steps: export public key, have Nebula import to their HSM, verify fingerprint. I'll run through the checklist tonight and post results.

Anna: Ownership summary (final): Network & FW = Kai, Artifact transfer & signer handshake = Josh (+Security), KMS coordination = Marie, Smoke + canary = SRE, Runbook + rollback = Anna. Cutover window 10:00-11:30 PT tomorrow. If anyone needs to reassign, say now. :thumbsup:

Kai: ACK. I’ll follow up once Nebula confirms CIDR allow.

Josh: ACK — will post PR review + signer preflight by 20:00 PT tonight.

Marie: ACK — will finish SOC 7.2 and KMS timeline by EOD.

SRE-Bot: Canary scheduled for 09:30 PT. Slack reminder 08:45 PT.
